description: Gripper Gen 16: radically simplified handheld gripper (sibling of Gen 15). Jake (voice): 'Focus on significant simplicity. It doesn't need that whole arm attachment bit; if it doesn't attach to my wrist, that's okay. It just needs a flat piece on the side that I can put my fingers in, my thumb on the other side, and a strap that goes over. Really simple. We don't need to actually draw the straps; that's unnecessary.' Spec: Gen 14 fingers (voice-fe67959c), made printable; a pivot; an Insta360 X4/X5 camera mount on top; each finger gets a simple flat side pad (fingers on one side, thumb on the other), each with one strap/zip-tie slot. No wrist/forearm attachment, straps not modeled, and the fewest possible parts. Mechanism stays above the hand with the thumb-index web clear. Build it independently of Gen 15 (Gen 15 is the fuller version); don't modify Gen 15. Printable STLs, parts list, and a gallery view with open/close and exploded view.

STL exports are gitignored like v015's; regenerate with export_models.py.
results.summary: Gen 16 is in the gallery: three printed parts, two fingers with flat thumb and index side pads, and one pivot plate that holds the camera.
results.detailed_description:
Gen 16 cuts Gen 15 down to three printed parts. Each finger is now one print with a flat 9 mm pad fused to its back: the right pad sits over your thumb, the left over your index finger, and each has one 4 × 22 mm slot for a strap or zip tie. One plate holds both pivots and the Insta360 X4/X5 cradle.

Gone: the hand frame, the wrist strap, the separate carriers and camera mount, and every M3 screw. The hardware is now two M4 pivot screws with lock nuts and one 1/4" camera screw. Straps aren't modelled. The fingers and their tip contact are Gen 15's, unchanged, and Gen 15 itself is untouched.

Checks pass: no collisions over the full 0–30° swing, the thumb-index web stays clear, and all walls are at least 0.8 mm. The pad size and slot position are my guesses, not measured on your hand. Print the two fingers and see how the pads sit. Parts list and print settings are in BOM.md.
results.user_reply_draft: Gen 16 is up. It's the simple one: three printed parts, a flat pad on each finger for your thumb and index finger with a strap slot, and the camera on top. No wrist piece. Print the fingers first and tell me how the pads fit.

summary: Gripper Gen 16 is a minimal handheld gripper using Gen 14 fingers, a pivot, a camera mount, and flat side pads with strap slots. Build it separately from Gen 15 with the fewest printable parts, delivering STLs, a parts list, and a gallery view.
